data.meaning: The main Claude session running SKILL.md. Plans, dispatches, verifies, asks the user, closes nodes. Never does a unit's work.
One fresh subagent run for one planned role of one node (worker or reviewer).
An abstract name in `produces`/`requires` (e.g. `approved-plan`). The node-to-node control contract.
Run number of a node; +1 on every invalidate. Records of older generations no longer count.
`<node>.g<G>.<unit>.r<R>`: names a packet, its rules file and its result file.
sha256 over what would be shipped from a repo; pinned at subject nodes and in receipts.
Per-repo proof that final-review approved this exact subject, valid for a TTL.
Who closes a node's G0: `controller` (recorded) or `user` (asked).
Optional capability (e.g. IF) that adds nodes at a slot and rules; enabled per ticket.
